fields.label: Crypto Key Backend
fields.help: The resource name of the backend environment associated with all CryptoKeyVersions within this CryptoKey.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Destroy Scheduled Duration
fields.help: The period of time that versions of this key spend in the DESTROY_SCHEDULED state before transitioning to DESTROYED.

fields.label: Import Only
fields.help: Whether this key may contain imported versions only.

fields.label: Key Ring
fields.help: The KeyRing that this key belongs to.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The resource name for the CryptoKey.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: The immutable purpose of this CryptoKey.

fields.label: Rotation Period
fields.help: Every time this period passes, generate a new CryptoKeyVersion and set it as the primary.

fields.label: Skip Initial Version Creation
fields.help: If set to true, the request will create a CryptoKey without any CryptoKeyVersions.

fields.label: Version Template
Algorithm
fields.help: The algorithm to use when creating a version based on this template.

fields.label: Protection Level
fields.help: The protection level to use when creating a version based on this template.
A template describing settings for new crypto key versions.
